 Order

ON BOARD  (15 / 06 /202 4)
1.
Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 37/2024 registered at Police Station - Kondagaon,
District Kondagaon (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 399, 402, 120B of IPC read with Section 25 of the Arms Act.
2.
Case of prosecution in brief is that police received secret information that some persons are making plan for committing Dacoity.
Based upon which, police reached the place where five persons were talking/planning for committing Dacoity, they were intercepted.

During investigation,
memorandum statement of accused persons were recorded and they were arrested on 24.01.2024.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime, he has not committed any offence as alleged.
Applicant is working as Watchman at Tarsen Bada, he was arrested on 24.01.2024 and after completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
The allegation against the applicant is that he along with other person was planning to commit dacoity which is false and baseless.
There is no material to connect the applicant in the aforementioned crime.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and further submits that applicant was involved in committing alleged offence.
There is one other criminal antecedent against applicant of offence under Section 380, 420 of IPC and Section 67 of the I.T. Act of the year 2021.

5. At this stage, learned counsel for applicant submits that earlier offence which is pointed out by the learned State counsel is compromised, relevant document is placed on record however the trial is still pending as the crime under Section Section 67 of the I.T. is non compoundable.
He submits that other similarly situated co-accused Prahalad Sinha, Umakant Jain have been enlarged on bail in MCRC No. 2437/2024 and MCRC No. 3247/2024 respectively on 22.04.2024 and 24.05.2024.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

7. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, submission of learned counsel for the respective parties, period of detention, charge-sheet is filed, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow this bail application.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail, upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of   25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that- a) Applicant shall appear before the Trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) The applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
